LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Setup.LetterText:
Crew, your away mission is to establish a small perimeter, deploy the subspace sensor array, and survey two alien obelisks detected from orbit.
1) Build and power a Subspace Sensor near each obelisk. 2) Perform a scan on both obelisks. 3) Transmit the collected telemetry to Starfleet via the beacon.
Starfleet notes: Local fauna exhibits irregular bioelectric responses to subspace harmonics. Disturbances may occur once telemetry is broadcast.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Spawned.Title: Obelisks located
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Spawned.Text: We have pinpointed two alien obelisks on this world. Their surface glyphs are consistent with unknown pre-warp symbology. Establish the sensors and begin scans.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.ScanA.OrderText: Bring the Subspace Sensor online near the first obelisk and start a scan. Keep a security cordon—ambient wildlife may react to the subspace ping.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.ScanA.SuccessText: The first obelisk’s subspace lattice has been mapped. Proceed to the second site and repeat the procedure.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.ScanB.OrderText: Power the sensor near the second obelisk and complete the scan to finish the local survey.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.ScanB.SuccessText: We now hold a paired dataset of harmonic glyph patterns. Consolidate the results and transmit to Starfleet from the communications beacon.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Transmit.OrderText: Use the beacon’s “Report to Starfleet” function to uplink the consolidated obelisk data. Expect local fauna agitation once the broadcast energizes the ionosphere.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Transmit.SentText: Starfleet confirms receipt. Stand by for preliminary analysis. Maintain a defensive posture until local conditions stabilize.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Manhunt.Title: Faunal disturbance detected
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Manhunt.Text: Subspace emission has triggered aggressive behavior in nearby wildlife. Hold the line and protect the equipment until the disturbance passes.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.II.Cleared.Title: Subspace window stabilized
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.II.Cleared.Text: The immediate threat has passed. Starfleet requests your recommendation on how to proceed with the obelisk sites.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIII.Title: Obelisk Survey — Phase III
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIII.Desc: Directive required. Subspace window is stable; select how to proceed with the sites.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIII.BriefBody: Both the Klingon Empire and the Romulan Star Empire file immediate claims: Klingons call the structures battle memorials of an ancient House; Romulans cite pre-Surak records. Ferengi brokers have already sniffed our telemetry and smell profit in every slab.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIII.ChoiceText: To avoid an incident, we can secure the site under Starfleet protocol—or move decisively to reach the presumed vault before claimants and profiteers converge.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Path.Warden.Label: Hold the site — Starfleet protocol
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Path.Warden.Title: Warden protocol confirmed
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Path.Warden.Text: Establish a secure perimeter, catalogue every artifact, and report status to Starfleet. Delegations are received under flag protocol; Ferengi activity is monitored and recorded.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Path.Vault.Label: Beat the claimants — to the vault
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Path.Vault.Title: Vault priority acknowledged
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Path.Vault.Text: Use the window. Decode the site geometry and locate the inner chamber before other parties intervene.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIV.Warden.Title: Obelisk Survey — Phase IV (Wardens)
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIV.Vault.Title: Obelisk Survey — Phase IV (Vault)
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseV.Title: Phase V: The Vault
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseV.Body: The obelisk arrangement suggests a sealed inner chamber. Several anomalies have been mapped; one should be the access point.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Title: Ferengi broker hails
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Body: A Ferengi offers “exclusive coordinates” to the inner ring for immediate consideration. Klingons laugh, Romulans say nothing — rarely a good sign. Your call?
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Deal.Label: Accept the deal (off-record)
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Refuse.Label: Refuse (maintain protocol)
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Deal.ConfirmText: Encrypted raster data received. Note attached: “noise-sensitive lock” — likely an acoustic or subsonic seal. Data has been integrated into our map.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Refuse.Title: Offer declined
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Ferengi.Refuse.Text: We cite Starfleet protocol. The broker “records future terms”; expect Ferengi scrutiny on subsequent transmissions.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.V.Vault.NextText: Anomalies marked. With the (lawful or “supplemented”) data, we should pinpoint and breach the access.
